title: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Gut Health
official: A Clinical Trial to Evaluate the Effects of a Supplement on Gut Health
summary:
This study will evaluate the effects of the Peachbiotic supplement on gut health in adults experiencing gastrointestinal symptoms. The trial is a single-arm, open-label, virtual study in which all 40 enrolled participants will use the test product daily for 12 weeks.

Participants will take one capsule of the product once daily in the morning with food and will complete self-reported questionnaires at Baseline, Week 4, Week 8, and Week 12 to assess changes in gut health outcomes including bloating, digestive comfort, regularity of bowel movements, gasiness, and general well-being.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be male or female
* Be aged 18-60
* Anyone who has been experiencing issues regarding at least two of the following for the past month: stomach discomfort, constipation, diarrhea, heartburn, bloating, gas, or abdominal pain
* If taking any other supplements or herbal remedies that target gut or digestive health, has been doing so consistently for at least three months and is willing to maintain this for the duration of the study
* Anyone willing to avoid introducing any other new supplements, medications, or herbal remedies for the duration of this trial
* Anyone willing to maintain their current diet, sleep pattern, and activity levels for the duration of the trial
* Anyone in good general health
* Resides in the United States

Exclusion Criteria:

* Anyone with a known history of severe digestive disorders like acid reflux, Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS), Irritable Bowel Disease (IBD), Crohn's disease, or gastrointestinal tract surgeries
* Anyone with any known allergies or hypersensitivities to any supplement product ingredients
* Anyone with a pineapple allergy
* Anyone with any chronic health conditions that could impact participation in this study, such as cancer, mental health disorders, history of serious illness in the last three months, history of substance abuse, or planned surgery during the study period
* Any women who are pregnant, breastfeeding, or trying to conceive (or who will be at any point during the study period)
* Anyone currently taking prescription anticoagulants ('blood thinners') or with a history of a bleeding disorder
* Anyone unwilling to follow the study protocol
* Currently partaking in another research study or will be partaking in any other research study at any point during this study's duration
